title: Layout without table context
description: Best-practice rule — flags layouts with no table occurrence context. They cannot show record data and are often stray or utility layouts.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A context-less layout cannot bind fields; it is usually a leftover or a dialog shell.
rule.remediation: Assign the intended table occurrence, or remove the layout if unused.
